topic: BSF kills Bangladeshi on Thakurgaon border
headline_marked: BSF firing: [[Bangladeshi man killed]] along Thakurgaon border
headline: BSF firing: Bangladeshi man killed along Thakurgaon border
summary: Asadul Haque, 38, died in an Indian hospital after being shot by the BSF during an alleged smuggling attempt.
details: A 38-year-old Bangladeshi man, Asadul Haque, has died after being shot by India's Border Security Force (BSF) in Thakurgaon's Pirganj upazila.
The incident occurred around 1:30 am yesterday when BSF personnel from the Chakshibananda camp opened fire on a group of alleged smugglers 1.5km inside Indian territory.
Asadul was injured in the firing and was taken to a hospital in Raiganj, West Bengal, where he later succumbed to his injuries.
According to a press release from the BGB 42 Battalion, Asadul was an identified drug smuggler and was also involved in human trafficking.
The BGB stated that several cases had been filed against him at the Pirganj Police Station regarding these activities.
Lt Col Abdullah Al Moin Hasan, commanding officer of BGB 42 Battalion, noted that the BSF has not yet officially informed them of the death.
The BGB has called for a flag meeting with the BSF today to discuss the incident and gather more details.

According to a press release from the BGB 42 Battalion, Asadul was an identified drug smuggler and was also involved in human trafficking.

The BGB stated that several cases had been filed against him at the Pirganj Police Station regarding these activities.

Lt Col Abdullah Al Moin Hasan, commanding officer of BGB 42 Battalion, noted that the BSF has not yet officially informed them of the death.

topic: Houthi control Bab al-Mandeb, oil fears
headline_marked: Ship hit by projectile in [[Strait of Hormuz attack]], oil supply fears grow
headline: Ship hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz attack, oil supply fears grow
summary: New attacks on shipping and a Saudi oil pipeline have sent Brent crude prices surging past $100 a barrel amid widening Middle East conflict.
details: A vessel was hit by a projectile while moving through the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday, according to the UKMTO. The damage to the ship and the status of its crew remain unknown.

The attack follows Saudi Arabia's temporary closure of its vital East-West pipeline after a drone strike. The pipeline, which moves 4-5 million barrels per day, is a critical route for global oil supplies.
Brent crude prices have surged back above $100 a barrel, and US diesel prices hit a record $6 a gallon. Experts warn that ongoing conflict in the region could drive energy prices even higher.

The Houthis have reportedly seized the strategic island of Perim in the Bab el-Mandeb strait, further threatening major oil routes. Saudi Arabia has requested US military assistance to fight the Houthis.
Iran has set seven conditions for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, including the recognition of its control over the waterway and the ability to collect fees from ships.
A meeting between Iran and Gulf Arab states is scheduled in Oman on Monday to discuss the future of the strait, though officials say a breakthrough is unlikely.
